Day 1
Today was a rough day because I'm still a beginner at Kicad. I spent a lot of my time trying to find the symbols in the .sym file, but I didn't read and typed button  in the search bar instead of typing sw_push. I managed to fix my mistake and began to do the simple connecting, which was the easiest part in my opinion.
